item.title: 'We are getting better at it': AI helps streamline genomic data analysis
item.description: Global experts are gathering in Huntsville this week to discuss the latest developments in artificial intelligence at the 2026 AI Symposium. Engineer Scott Newberry presented about how HudsonAlpha Institute for Biotechnology is using AI to streamline data collection and prediction.
